typography.font_characteristics: heavy display for hooks (optionally pixel/mono); geometric sans for support; dual-tone near-black + terminal green on light stage

dual_tone.rule: Key nouns/verbs in near-black bold; accent words in terminal green. In-frame dual-tone is primary; karaoke pill is slim support.

color.background_treatment: LIGHT studio gray/off-white (#EDEDED–#F4F4F4); optional subtle cool wash or soft vignette. NEVER near-black void stage.
color.accent_usage: single terminal green for keywords, list headers, UI chrome only

imagery.asset_rule: Every content image must depict what THAT scene's VO says. Search query = narration nouns. Vision-check before lock. No random AI-brain / abstract filler.

motion_graphics.zoom_behavior: slow push-in on cards; punch-in on keyword reveals
overlays: optional faint light grid at ~3% opacity
motion_graphics.borders: 1px #39FF14 hairlines on terminal cards; soft gray card edges
motion_graphics.gradients: none on canvas; soft shadow falloff only
motion_graphics.shadows: soft diffuse under host and cards (y+8..20, blur 30..60, opacity ~0.25)

audio.bgm: optional light bed ducked under VO

hierarchy.visual_hierarchy: graphic/kinetic upper-mid → host lower-left → slim karaoke above safe zone → empty footer
hierarchy.emphasis_timing: caption words land with stressed syllables; host expression swaps on scene boundaries

watermark.footer_policy: leave bottom 8% clear unless user supplies their own brand

host_playback.note: Host GIF/WebP plays at native 12fps 1x. Never compress a 4–8s mouth loop into a 2s scene. Soft loop or freeze — do not speed up.

notes: LIGHT studio greencode. Script-matched photos only. Host GIFs at native 1x (12fps keyed). No black stage. No GREENCODE/PATTERN chrome.
